title: Pre-Authorisation Request Triage for TPAs
summary: Read incoming cashless requests, check completeness, policy terms and tariffs, and put a prioritised, source-linked summary in front of the TPA medical officer.

seo.title: AI Pre-Authorisation Triage for TPAs | VipraTech
seo.description: AI that reads cashless pre-auth requests, checks documents, policy terms and tariffs, drafts hospital queries and prioritises the medical officer queue.

problem.intro: Network hospitals send cashless requests at all hours: the pre-authorisation form, the treating doctor's notes, investigation reports and a cost estimate, sometimes as a fax turned into a PDF. The medical officer has to work out what is being asked, whether the file is complete and what the policy allows, against a clock that patients, hospitals and IRDAI all watch.

pain_points.title: Incomplete requests cause back-and-forth
pain_points.detail: Missing investigation reports, unsigned forms or an absent cost break-up trigger query letters, and every query keeps the patient waiting at the admission desk.

pain_points.title: Policy terms checked from memory
pain_points.detail: Waiting periods, pre-existing disease declarations, room-rent eligibility and procedure sub-limits sit on different screens, so checks vary between medical officers.

pain_points.title: Tariff and package mismatches
pain_points.detail: Estimates that exceed the hospital's agreed package or tariff are easy to miss when requests are read in a hurry.

pain_points.title: Flat queues hide urgent cases
pain_points.detail: An emergency admission, an enhancement at discharge and a planned cataract surgery can sit in the same first-in, first-out queue.

solution.overview: We build a triage layer that sits between hospital requests and your medical officers. It reads each request, identifies whether it is an initial request, an enhancement or a final discharge approval, and extracts the clinical and cost details. It checks the file against a procedure-specific document checklist, looks up the member's policy terms and the hospital's agreed tariff or package, and builds a one-screen summary with every fact linked to its source page. Incomplete files get a drafted query for the desk team. Complete files are ranked by urgency for a medical officer, who makes the decision in your existing TPA system.
capabilities: Recognises request type: initial authorisation, enhancement or final discharge approval
Extracts provisional diagnosis, proposed line of treatment, expected length of stay, room category and estimated cost
Checks completeness against document checklists configured per procedure or specialty
Looks up waiting periods, pre-existing disease declarations, sub-limits and room-rent eligibility from the policy record
Compares the estimate with the hospital's agreed tariff or package rate and highlights differences
Drafts query letters for missing items and ranks complete requests using urgency rules set by your medical team

workflow.title: Receive the request
workflow.detail: Requests arrive from the hospital portal, a shared inbox or fax-to-email and are matched to the member and the hospital.

workflow.title: Identify and extract
workflow.detail: The request type is identified, and clinical, cost and member fields are extracted with source-page references.

workflow.title: Check completeness
workflow.detail: A procedure-specific checklist confirms the required documents; incomplete files go to the desk team with a drafted query.

workflow.title: Look up policy and tariff
workflow.detail: Policy terms and the hospital's agreed tariff or package are pulled and compared with the request.

workflow.title: Prioritise and summarise
workflow.detail: Complete requests are ranked by urgency rules and presented as a one-screen summary with flags.

workflow.title: Medical officer decides
workflow.detail: The medical officer approves, partially approves, queries or declines in the TPA system, and the decision and reasons are logged.

inputs: Treating doctor's notes and provisional diagnosis
Hospital cost estimate and tariff or package reference
Member e-card, policy record and claim history
Enhancement requests and final bills at later stages
outputs: Structured pre-auth record with source-page links
Completeness status and list of missing documents
Drafted query letter for the hospital
Policy and tariff flags such as waiting period, sub-limit or package variance
Urgency rank and one-screen summary for the medical officer
Turnaround log from receipt to decision
human_in_the_loop: Medical officers make every approval, partial approval, query and denial, and desk staff review each drafted query before it is sent. The system never contacts the hospital with a decision on its own and never judges medical necessity.
integrations: TPA or insurer cashless platform (via API or database staging)
Policy administration system or member master
MIS and data warehouse for turnaround reporting
guardrails: No automatic approval or denial at any stage
Clinical fields shown only when found in the documents, with the source page; absent information is marked absent, not inferred
Urgency rules written and versioned by the medical team
Drafted queries reviewed by a person before sending
Health data masked in logs and kept in your chosen cloud region
compliance_notes: Helps TPAs and insurers work towards IRDAI expectations on time-bound cashless decisions while keeping clinical judgement with qualified medical officers.
Processes health data only for claim handling, supporting purpose limitation under India's DPDP Act 2023.

pilot.scope: Planned surgical admissions from a small group of high-volume network hospitals, run in shadow mode next to your current cashless desk.
deliverables: Request-type and field schema agreed with your medical team
Procedure checklists for the pilot specialties
Working triage pipeline on de-identified historical and live requests

faqs.q: Does it suggest ICD-10 or procedure codes?
faqs.a: It can suggest codes from the provisional diagnosis and proposed treatment, clearly marked as suggestions. Your coders or medical officers confirm or change them, and those corrections improve later suggestions.

faqs.q: Can it handle enhancements and final discharge approvals?
faqs.a: Yes. It recognises enhancement requests and final bills, compares them with the amount already authorised and highlights what has changed, so the medical officer can focus on the difference.

faqs.q: Will it decide whether a treatment is medically necessary?
faqs.a: No. It organises the facts and flags gaps or policy issues. Medical necessity and every authorisation decision stay with your medical officers.

faqs.q: Where does tariff and package data come from?
faqs.a: From your existing provider tariff and package master, through an export or API. If agreed rates live in PDFs or spreadsheets, we extract them into a structured table during the pilot.
